description: July birthdays: zodiac signs and decans for every day of July, cusp dates, the month's numerology and its Chinese zodiac boundary.
answer: In Western astrology, July birthdays fall under Cancer and Leo. In most years July birthdays from the 1st to the 22nd are Cancer, and from the 23rd they are Leo. July 21, July 22, July 23 and July 24 are cusp dates. In numerology July is month 7.

sections.heading: Zodiac signs and decans in July
paragraphs: July begins with the closing day of Cancer's first decan and moves on July 2 into the second, where Pluto as sub-ruler deepens the Crab's tenderness into intense loyalty. Around July 13 the third decan begins, and Neptune makes the sign more imaginative, artistic and porous. Then, around July 22 or 23, the Sun enters Leo, and the month changes temperature: cardinal water gives way to fixed fire, private feeling to open self-expression. Late-July birthdays sit in Leo's first decan, where the Sun rules twice and warmth and presence come to the fore. The arc of July runs from the home to the stage, and those born near the boundary often describe a sensitive heart wrapped in a confident, generous manner that few people see past at first.

In most years July birthdays from the 1st to the 22nd are Cancer, and from the 23rd they are Leo. The cusp dates, where the sign can differ by year or time zone, are July 21, 22, 23 and 24; each has its own page explaining both possibilities. Decan by decan, the month opens in the first decan of Cancer, linked with Moon, from the 2nd the second decan of Cancer, linked with Pluto, from the 13th the third decan of Cancer, linked with Neptune and from the 23rd the first decan of Leo, linked with Sun.

sections.heading: July birthdays in numerology and the Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: July is month 7 in numerology, a number linked with introspection, investigative curiosity and a search for meaning. It is often read as adding depth and a need for solitude to a birth date, which can feel surprising in the year's most sociable season. July birthdays follow the calendar year's Chinese animal. Within Four Pillars astrology the Goat month, sometimes called the Sheep month, starts around July 6 to 8 with the solar term Minor Heat, so most July birthdays carry the Goat in the month pillar. The Goat is traditionally associated with gentleness, artistry and a strong need for peace, which chimes with the Neptunian end of Cancer and gives the reflective 7 a softer, more creative outlet than its reputation for analysis might suggest.
Every page for a July date lists the Life Path for several birth years, because the year changes the total even when the day stays the same.

sections.heading: Famous July birthdays
paragraphs: Each July page lists the best-known people born on that date, drawn from Wikidata and ranked by how many Wikipedia language editions have an article about them. A sample across the month: Diana, Princess of Wales (July 1), Calvin Coolidge (July 4), Gustav Mahler (July 7), Nikola Tesla (July 10), Harrison Ford (July 13), Roald Amundsen (July 16), Vladimir Mayakovsky (July 19), Selena Gomez (July 22), Rosalind Franklin (July 25), Hugo Chávez (July 28) and J. K. Rowling (July 31). Sharing a birthday with someone well known says nothing about a life's direction, but it is a pleasant way into the date's sign, decan and numbers, which each page then explains in turn. The lists favour people with a precisely recorded birth date in the modern Gregorian calendar, so some much-celebrated figures from earlier centuries are missing.

faq.question: What is the numerology number of July?
faq.answer: July is month 7. The month is one of three parts of the Life Path calculation, with the day and the year.

faq.question: Which Chinese zodiac animal is someone born in July?
faq.answer: Lunar New Year has always passed by July, so a July birth takes the animal of the calendar birth year.
